descriptive_basis.interpretation: Large negative development years and highly dispersed volatility motivate selective exposure to the daily-reset leveraged path rather than full-time leverage. Near-zero/negative daily autocorrelation provides no descriptive basis for a daily directional pattern.

prospective_design.family: Two-horizon gross compounding agreement with optional volatility ceiling
prospective_design.signal: Both trailing sums of log(1 + 3 * raw-derived QQQ daily total return) must be strictly positive. Optional 63-session QQQ annualized sample volatility must not exceed 30%.
prospective_design.window_rationale: 126 and 252 sessions span roughly half-year and one-year evidence; 21 and 63 sessions supply roughly one-month and three-month current-direction agreement. These are coarse calendar-scale alternatives, not fitted exact dates.
prospective_design.ceiling_rationale: 30% is a round cutoff above the development 63-session volatility upper quartile (27.0%) and below the 90th percentile (40.4%); no ceiling is the necessary ablation.
prospective_design.cap_rationale: One-third and two-thirds of the daily-reset 3x instrument give initial approximate underlying exposures of 1x and 2x. They remain fixed eligibility allocations, not continuously maintained risk targets, and holdings may drift until target changes.
prospective_design.costs: Fixed engine expense layer including trading, funding, expense and tracking drag. No cost parameter optimization.
prospective_design.development_objective: Inspect expense-layer cash-excess Sharpe, CAGR, drawdown, turnover and annual consistency; taxes are not a development selection objective.
prospective_design.initial_grid: 16 policy configurations plus four constant-allocation negative controls. All are logged, including failure or negative returns.
prospective_design.complexity_ranking: Two horizon gates: 2. Added volatility gate: 3. Constant negative controls: 0, ineligible for proposal.
prospective_design.insufficient_history: Cash until max(long, short, volatility window) + 1 supplied observations. No inherited position at scored start.

initial_batch_findings.one_month_gate: 21-session confirmation variants generated about 164-172 changes and generally zero or negative excess Sharpe; rejected from the final proposal.
initial_batch_findings.three_month_gate: 63-session confirmation generated about 100-122 changes and modest positive excess Sharpe, but annual gains were concentrated and many development years underperformed cash.
initial_batch_findings.volatility_ablation: The 30% ceiling reduced excess Sharpe for the stronger 126/63 pair, while mildly improving some weaker one-year-window configurations. No consistent benefit sufficient to retain its added complexity.
initial_batch_findings.leverage_tradeoff: Two-thirds allocations had only slightly higher arithmetic excess Sharpe, but substantially greater drawdowns and often lower CAGR than one-third allocations. Both caps remain because there is no strong development-only basis for a universal winner.
initial_batch_findings.negative_control_warning: Constant full 3x had positive arithmetic cash-excess Sharpe despite approximately -14.8% CAGR and -97.0% drawdown. Arithmetic Sharpe is not a guarantee of viable compounding.

final_neighborhood_plan.reason: Check coarse neighboring calendar-scale windows around the better 126/63 agreement pair without introducing a new policy family, feature, exact fitted cutoff, or cost optimization.
final_neighborhood_plan.planned_final_grid: Exactly 12 configurations: unfiltered pairs (84,63), (126,42), (126,63), (126,84), (189,63), (252,63), each at one-third and two-thirds caps. Freeze all 12 regardless of neighborhood results; do not greedily trim to the development top performers.

development_findings.neighborhood_interpretation: The 84-session shorter path improved development outcomes versus 63; the 42-session gate was weak. The precommitted neighborhood grid is retained intact, including weak alternatives. No additional tuning follows these observations.
development_findings.interpretation: At most modest development evidence, not an established edge. Risk avoidance substantially reduced catastrophic full-3x drawdown, but many timing variants failed to beat cash and profits were episodic.

limitations: Only one underlying instrument and ten scored development years; no external market or later-period observations have been inspected.
Eight coarse neighborhood configurations were selected adaptively after the initial results; 28 total configurations create selection optimism despite the small search.
No uncertainty interval, significance claim, robustness across other instruments, or demonstrated persistent economic edge is asserted.
Gates can repeatedly switch around zero growth and incur whipsaw costs; performance remains sensitive to calendar-scale windows.
Gross compounding features do not incorporate funding/cash rates; full causal funding and fixed costs enter the development accounting results instead.
The traded 3x path is a synthetic daily-reset model, not an observed investable instrument history. Fixed fee/slippage/funding/expense/tracking assumptions are research assumptions.
Fractional allocations drift between target changes and do not maintain a target volatility or stable underlying exposure.
Arithmetic cash-excess Sharpe can be positive even when leverage causes unacceptable compounding and drawdown; the full-3x negative control demonstrates this explicitly.
Taxes were not a development objective. Tax assumptions are hypothetical and this policy is not personal financial advice.
All twelve declared final configurations remain frozen, including weak development alternatives; no performance-dependent fallback or post-handoff policy editing is supplied.
